# Labor Market Power: From Micro Evidence to Macro Consequences

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** David Berger, Kyle Herkenhoff, Simon Mongey  
**Year:** 2026  
**Journal:** Journal of Economic Perspectives  
**DOI:** [10.1257/jep.20251456](https://doi.org/10.1257/jep.20251456)

**Keywords:** labor market power, monopsony, wages, employment, market concentration

## Abstract

Synthesizes micro evidence on labor market power and its macroeconomic consequences, examining how employer concentration affects wages, employment, and aggregate economic outcomes.
